Hi Alicia / Rajesh,

Thanks again for the call today — appreciate the context on the integration goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can scope the POC properly.

POC goal / success criteria (proposed):
- Integration end-to-end with Redwood API serving 1 production flow (card-verification assistant)
- Latency: 95th perc <= 350ms for normal traffic (non-burst)
- Cost: within the budget envelope we discussed (TBD final)
- Quality: parity with your internal prompt set (we'll run evals during trial)
- Security: data stays within VPC and keys managed by your KMS (confirm)

Evaluation plan / timeline (proposed):
- Week 0: intake & access (this week)
- Week 1: infra onboarding, baseline tests
- Week 2: traffic replay & tuning
- Week 3: final evaluation + wrap-up

What I need from you to finalize the intake: a quick workload profile covering the items below (I attached a template):
- Typical RPS (avg) and expected peak RPS
- Concurrency targets (simultaneous open sessions)
- Typical request token length and response token length (avg / 95th)
- Burst patterns: duration and frequency (e.g., 30s spikes to 400 RPS every morning)
- Retry/backoff behavior and SLAs for retries
- Any non-standard requests (embeddings, reranking, long context >8k tokens)

Owners / next steps:
- Ben Carter (me): commercial & kickoff scheduling
- Marissa Cole (cc): solutions engineering lead for POC onboarding

I've attached the Redwood POC intake template to make this quick: redwood_poc_intake_template.xlsx
Can you fill in the sheet or reply with the key numbers? If you prefer a short sync, I'm available Wed/Thu afternoon PST.

Thanks,

Thanks Ben — great recap. See answers below and I attached our current traffic export and a network diagram for the infra team.

Quick answers (high level):
- Typical RPS (avg): 120 RPS across peak business hours (US East)
- Expected peak RPS: 420 RPS (short bursts, typically 20-45s)
- Concurrency: ~85 concurrent sessions at peak (web+mobile combined)
- Token lengths: average request 160 tokens; avg response 220 tokens; 95th response ~1,800 tokens for long-form reconciliation flows
- Burst patterns: daily spike around 09:30-10:00 ET and again 15:00 ET; unpredictable marketing-driven spikes (can double traffic for ~2-5 mins)
- Retry behavior: clients do 3 retries with exponential backoff; most retries are at 1s / 2s / 4s
- Non-standard: we will send embeddings for a small subset (<5% traffic) and have one workflow that needs 8k+ context (rare)

Kickoff: Rajesh (cc) will lead the technical onboarding. He can do Wed Nov 4 at 10:00 AM PT.

Hi Rajesh / Alicia — looking forward to the kickoff tomorrow. A few technical clarifications so we can prepare the right infra and test harness: 

1) Request types: can you confirm approximate split between chat-style interactive requests vs. one-shot completions vs. embeddings? (Alicia said embeddings ~5% but want approximate split)
2) For the long-form 8k+ context workflow: is that single request (~1 input doc + expected ~1.5k response) or multi-turn chaining?
3) Tokenization: are you using a custom tokenizer or standard UTF-8 tokenization? If you have example payloads we can run tokenization locally.
4) Peak concurrency details: you listed ~85 concurrent sessions — is that per region or across regions? Also, do you expect sustained concurrency during marketing spikes?
5) Error handling: what constitutes acceptable error rates during the POC? (e.g., <1% 5xx during normal traffic)

If you can drop a short JSON with a couple of example payloads that include both a typical request and your 8k context example, that would speed up validation. I've attached a short intake checklist and we'll include it on the kickoff agenda.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Marissa — attaching two sample payloads (typical request + long-form example) and a small CSV with minute-level RPS samples for the last 30 days. Rajesh will be on the kickoff and can answer the remaining infra questions.

A couple of notes from our side:
- We use standard tokenization (not custom).
- The 8k+ workflow is single-request document ingestion followed by a long-form analysis response (so single request with large context).
- Peak concurrency is across regions; this POC will focus on our US East region initially.
- Retry aggregation: we have a gateway that will retry once on 5xx; clients do the remaining backoffs.
- For the POC, aim for <1% 5xx under normal traffic; we can be more lenient during aggressive burst testing.

Also, can you confirm how Redwood charges for the trial environment? We prefer a predictable consumption cap for the trial.

See attached: fintechx_sample_payloads.json, fintechx_minute_rps_30days.csv
